author: fedric95
description:
The SAR data are obtained from the UMBRA Open Data Program (https://umbra.space/open-data/).
The dataset has been created combining the WorldCover by ESA (https://esa-worldcover.org/en) with the UMBRA images.
BIOME information has been extracted from the RESOLVE biome dataset (https://ecoregions.appspot.com/).
Reverse geo-coding with OSM nominatim (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org).
